headline: Financing of the general state budget exceeds legal limit
summary: The proposed 2027 General State Budget envisions financing equal to 3.4% of GDP, above the 3% limit set by Law 6-06 on Public Credit. The Chamber of Accounts recommended Congress demand explanations or adjust the amount.
why: Public financing needs above legal limits affect government borrowing, fiscal credibility and the sovereign risk assessment investors apply to the country.
original_headline: Financiamiento del presupuesto general del estado supera límite legal
